decisions.Visual theme & density: Originally: playful Claymorphism. Updated 2026-04-23: academic Glassmorphism aligned with The University of Hong Kong — EB Garamond + Crimson Text, blue-forward palette (#2563EB primary, #3B82F6 secondary, #F8FAFC background). See 03-UI-SPEC.md and design-system/ai-quiz-generator/MASTER.md.
decisions.\"Generating\" state experience: Skeleton loaders with stepped copy; avoid infinite bouncing. Style updated to match Glassmorphism (layered, subtle pulse) rather than bubbly Clay.
decisions.Question presentation: Card-based grid (one question per card) with depth; glass-style surfaces per UI-SPEC.
decisions.Answer reveal behavior: Immediate reveal with clear feedback; micro-interactions updated to academic tone (subtle blue/red glow, soft fade) per UI-SPEC.
decisions.Question count control: Increment control with minus/plus; min 0, max 10 (backend GenerateTextRequest aligned: ge=0, le=10). Replaces fixed 5/10/15/20 select.
decisions.Institutional theme: Designated for HKU: professional academic look; ui-ux-pro-max design system persisted; MASTER.md is canonical for tokens.
